tasks.task: Navigate to the obituary publishing section and submit a new obituary with a title, content, and image.
tasks.expected: The obituary should be successfully published, appear on the user's dashboard, and be accessible to other users from the main obituaries page.

tasks.task: Look up the list of local mortuaries available on the website.
tasks.expected: The list should display comprehensive details about each mortuary, including name, location, and contact information.

tasks.task: Leave a condolence message on an existing obituary.
tasks.expected: The message should be successfully posted under the selected obituary and visible to other users.

tasks.task: Check the statistics page for the statistical analysis of obituary-related data.
tasks.expected: The page should display clear and relevant statistics, such as the number of obituaries published, the most recent obituaries, or any trend analysis available.

tasks.task: Navigate through the website using the main navigation menu.
tasks.expected: Each link in the navigation menu should lead to the appropriate section or page, and the navigation menu should remain consistent across all pages.

tasks.task: Verify that the website uses 'cornsilk' as the background color and 'peru' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
tasks.expected: The website has a background color of 'cornsilk' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'peru', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

tasks.task: In the inscription designer, pick Rosa Delgado from the memorial list and look at the preview.
tasks.expected: The preview fills in 'Rosa Delgado' with her dates July 4, 1945 – January 18, 2024 and shows the age she reached as 78 — not 79 — because the July birthday had not yet arrived by January.

tasks.task: Pick any memorial in the inscription designer and type a few characters of an epitaph while watching the preview and the character count.
tasks.expected: The engraved preview and the remaining-character count update as each character is typed, without needing to submit or save.

tasks.task: In the inscription designer, pick Harold Finch, type the epitaph 'A devoted father, grandfather, and friend to absolutely everyone' (well over 40 characters), and try to save.
tasks.expected: The designer flags the epitaph as over the 40-character limit and refuses to save; no inscription appears on Harold Finch's obituary page.

tasks.task: Pick Rosa Delgado in the inscription designer, type the epitaph 'Beloved teacher and friend', save it, then open Rosa Delgado's obituary page.
tasks.expected: The finished inscription appears on Rosa Delgado's obituary page showing 'Beloved teacher and friend', with her dates written with the month spelled out, like 'July 4, 1945'.

tasks.task: Open an obituary from the main obituaries listing, type a condolence message into its message form, and submit it.
tasks.expected: The condolence message appears under that obituary, visible with the rest of its messages.

tasks.task: On the browse page, select both the Veteran and Educator categories.
tasks.expected: Exactly 4 memorials show — Harold Finch, Walter Brandt, Samuel Whitcombe, and Rosa Delgado — with Samuel Whitcombe listed once (not duplicated for holding both tags), and the visible count reads 4.

tasks.task: On the browse page with no filters applied, choose the 'newest passing first' sort.
tasks.expected: The order is Harold Finch, Miriam Okafor, Lena Kowalski, Samuel Whitcombe, Rosa Delgado, Walter Brandt — Harold and Miriam share April 5, 2024 and tie alphabetically, and Walter (December 2, 2023) comes last, proving real date ordering rather than text ordering.

tasks.task: Select the Artist category together with the 1920s birth-decade filter.
tasks.expected: No memorials match, and the page shows a clear no-results message instead of a blank or broken area.

tasks.task: Publish a new obituary for 'Clara Voss' (born February 2, 1950, died March 3, 2024, category Artist), then open the browse page and filter by Artist.
tasks.expected: Clara Voss appears in the Artist results together with Miriam Okafor (1958–2024).

tasks.task: On the 'On This Date' page, type April 5 as the date.
tasks.expected: Exactly two people appear — Harold Finch (1932–2024) and Miriam Okafor (1958–2024) — both marked as passing anniversaries.

tasks.task: Type March 12 into the date lookup.
tasks.expected: Harold Finch appears labeled as a birthday anniversary and Lena Kowalski as a passing anniversary — the two kinds are visibly distinguished.

tasks.task: Type August 1 into the date lookup, then change it to February 29.
tasks.expected: August 1 shows a friendly no-matches message without the page blanking; February 29 then shows Walter Brandt, born February 29, 1940.
